programs.name: Aging and Disability Resources for Colorado (ADRC)
programs.organization: Colorado Department of Human Services, State Unit on Aging
programs.description: A statewide line that connects you to your local Area Agency on Aging for meals, in-home services, transportation, caregiver support and senior legal assistance. Military service is not required.
programs.next_step: Call 844-265-2372 (1-844-COL-ADRC) from anywhere in Colorado. Choose a county above for the direct number of its Area Agency on Aging.
constraints: Each program has its own eligibility and waitlist.

programs.name: Colorado Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
programs.organization: Colorado State Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
programs.description: Statewide advocacy for residents of long-term care facilities, delivered through 16 regional ombudsman programs.
programs.next_step: Choose your county for its regional ombudsman, or call the state ombudsman at 303-862-3524. To report mistreatment of an at-risk adult, call the Adult Protective Services intake number at the county department of human services where the adult lives. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.

programs.name: Colorado Legal Services
programs.description: Free civil legal help for people with low income and for older adults (60 and older), including help responding to an eviction notice. Not criminal or traffic law.
programs.next_step: Apply at coloradolegalservices.org or call the main office. Have your county and the legal problem ready.
constraints: Applicants are screened; this is not a quick-advice hotline. Income, case type and capacity limits apply, and local offices serve different counties.

programs.name: VA medical centers serving Colorado
programs.description: VA Eastern Colorado Health Care System: Rocky Mountain Regional VA Medical Center, Aurora (303-399-8020), with community clinics across eastern Colorado, including Colorado Springs, La Junta, Lamar and Salida. VA Western Colorado Health Care System: Grand Junction VA Medical Center (970-242-0731).
programs.next_step: Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic and its medical center. Not enrolled yet? Ask your County Veterans Service Officer for help applying.
constraints: VA does not publish county lists for these systems, so this card does not assign counties. Your VA care team may be at a different clinic or system; follow what VA tells you.

coverage_scope: Referral edition. All 64 counties have their County Veterans Service Office, a matched Area Agency on Aging and a regional long-term-care ombudsman.
coverage_note: Veterans Service Office addresses, phones and hours come from the Colorado Division of Veterans Affairs county office list; where it prints no office phone (Clear Creek, Huerfano, Jackson, Moffat, Washington) the card shows the service officers’ numbers or the shared office number the list names. Area Agencies on Aging, their counties and phones come from the Disability Law Colorado list dated September 9, 2021. Regional ombudsman cards show the Area Agency on Aging main line, because no separate regional ombudsman phones were read from official pages.
